```yaml
name: UI Core Components Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
    paths:
      - 'openmetadata-ui/**'
      - '.github/workflows/ui-core-components-tests.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
    paths:
      - 'openmetadata-ui/**'
      - '.github/workflows/ui-core-components-tests.yml'

jobs:
  test-ui-core:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ./openmetadata-ui

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'yarn'
          cache-dependency-path: openmetadata-ui/yarn.lock

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install Playwright Browsers
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
        # Note: The version of Playwright installed here is determined by package.json (1.54.2)
        # This step ensures the browsers compatible with @playwright/test 1.54.2 are installed.

      - name: Run UI Core Component Tests
        run: yarn test:unit

      - name: Upload Test Results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ui-test-results
          path: openmetadata-ui/test-results/
```
